optimizedDescription.value: CLI executes one Core-governed lifecycle hop with generic check-bus hook progress and canonical failure guidance.

optimizedContext.value:
# Change Transition
## Rules
- specd change transition name [step] [--next]: name plus exactly step/next; usage error exit 1 before TransitionChange. skip-checks plus legacy allow-out-of-scope=impl.linksInScope, allow-overlap=spec.overlap; pass skipChecks.
- next passes to next; Core resolves enabled single hop. CLI never routing/optional shortcut; unavailable next exit 1 stderr error.
- Use canonical GetStatus/TransitionChange reconciliation; report actual recovery. No retry/alternate target/attempt restart/verifying self hop/attempt claims. No direct tracking refresh; status refreshImplementationTracking false, transition default refresh.
- No approval flags/target rewrite; kernel config gates; gates remain ready/done.
- Default source.post then target.pre then transition, fail-fast. skip-hooks maps skipHookPhases; all requires manual change run-hooks.
- onProgress generic check bus; hooks rendered Running pre/post hooks; text label/id plus progress and pass/fail/skip, never Executing. Recheck only when hooks ran.
- JSON/TOON stdout NDJSON stream change-transition, terminal complete result. Text progress stderr, confirmation stdout. Hook failure exit 2 error, no Repair Guide.
- Predicate failures use canonical Repair Guide, code/gerund/remediation/exact skippable bypass. Task/requires failures exit 1 and name blocking artifact.
## Constraints
- Help logical target only; Core projects blockers/action; HookFailedError not Repair Guide.
